title: Dental PPO Plans Withdrawal, Free-Look Return, Voluntary Termination and Plan Change
content:
**Subscriber's own decisions.** Withdrawing an application, returning a policy in the free-look period, ending coverage and changing plans under the Dental PPO Plans are the subscriber's own decisions: the agent registers a coverage-change request and the change is carried out only after the subscriber confirms it. A withdrawal, free-look cancellation, voluntary termination or plan change is carried out only once the subscriber's coverage-change request for that enrollment is confirmed (as the request record shows).

**Withdrawal.** An application may be withdrawn at any time before the coverage effective date; it is void and any binder received is credited back in full.

**Free-look return (time condition).** An individual or individual exchange subscriber may return the policy no later than the free-look period after the coverage effective date of the enrollment. The free-look period is the plan's free-look days counted in calendar days from the coverage effective date, and a request confirmed on the last day is in time. A free-look cancellation voids coverage from the start, credits back all premium paid for the enrollment, and is not available once any claim line has been paid under the enrollment. Group enrollments have no free-look right.

**Voluntary termination.** Coverage ends on the last day of the calendar month in which the request is confirmed; premium billed for any later month is credited back, earlier months are not refunded, and the re-enrollment lockout then applies to individual-market enrollments.

**Plan change.** On an individual or individual exchange enrollment a plan change takes effect only on the next benefit period start date after the request is confirmed; a group enrollment changes plan only at the group's open-enrollment effective date or with a special enrollment, and only to plans the group contract offers. All enrollments of the subscriber on the same billing account change together, upgrades carry the upgrade waiting-period rule, and the new monthly premium for the coverage tier applies from the change effective date.

**Not provided for.** A request for a retroactive termination, for a mid-year plan change outside these occasions, or for a refund of months already covered.

### Free-look boundary (hypothetical, 10-day period, coverage effective 1 May)
A return confirmed on 11 May is in time; one confirmed on 12 May is not.
